05543 Calluw {sal-loo'} 或 Calluw' {sal-loo'}
  或 Caluw {sal-loo'}; 或 Callay {sal-lah'-ee}

源自 05541; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Sallu 3, Sallai 2, Salu 1; 6

撒路 或 撒來 = "有重量的"

1) 所羅巴伯時期的一位祭司 (#尼 12:7, 20|)
2) 西緬支派首領心利的父親 (#民 25:14|)
3) 一名被擄後的便雅憫人 (#代上 9:7; 尼 11:7|)
4) 一名被擄歸回的便雅憫人 (#尼11:8|)
record.edic_text:
05543 Calluw {sal-loo'} or Calluw' {sal-loo'}
  or Caluw {sal-loo'}; or Callay {sal-lah'-ee}

from 05541;; n pr m

AV - Sallu 3, Sallai 2, Salu 1; 6

Sallu or Salu or Sallai = "weighed"
1) a priest in the time of Zerubbabel
2) father of Zimri, the prince of the Simeonites, who was slain by
   Phinehas
3) a post exilic Benjamite
